svg.title: Rendering operation counts
svg.desc: Each optimization was measured separately against upstream 068ad22. Each row has its own unit; its original count is normalized to 100%. Counts are not CPU savings. Map PNG encodes: 149 original to 41 optimized PNG encodes. Button · 12 cycles · Chrome / Blink. Initial SVG attribute writes: 182 original to 62 optimized SVG attribute mutations. Static lens · Chrome / Blink. Scroll geometry reads: 33,524 original to 8,561 optimized geometry API reads. 240 extra surfaces · 35 positions · Chrome. Idle WebGL source uploads: 18 original to 0 optimized source texture uploads. Unchanged ImageBitmap · 302 ms · Chrome. Source: evidence.json; SHA-256: c0a594e4945862915435f7b7e2b859f2d87a61982de25674655336efbeb91c57
